selection_rule: highest mean training-LOBO stage balanced accuracy
then lowest mean training-LOBO lifetime MAE
notes: Candidate selection is performed only by leave-one-training-bearing-out evaluation within Bearing1_1 to Bearing1_3.
Each held or evaluation bearing contributes only its first 15 embeddings to its own causal scale and reference.
The selected method is frozen before Bearing1_4 and Bearing1_5 metrics are computed.
Normalized lifetime and three equal-width stages are chronological proxies, not physical damage labels.
All bearings were inspected previously; this is a fixed diagnostic, not a pristine blind test.
